headline: Rendered-evidence visual audit landed (docs/visual-audit-2026-09-18.html). Storybook did not build on a clean clone — src/app/data/component-api.json is gitignored and only prebuild:lib generated it, and build-storybook still exited 0 on failure; the same pattern broke pnpm typecheck via token-audit-report.json. Both now have pre-steps. Storybook also had no staticDirs, so every story rendered in a fallback face instead of Satoshi. Audit found 4 P0 / 3 P1 / 2 P2 drift findings plus 6 direction calls for Adrian.
